title: Standard shipping
text: Standard shipping is free on orders over Rs 499. Orders below Rs 499 pay a flat Rs 49 delivery fee. Standard delivery takes 3 to 6 business days in metro cities and 5 to 9 business days elsewhere.

title: Express shipping
text: Express shipping costs Rs 99 and delivers within 1 to 2 business days in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune and Delhi NCR. Express is not available for furniture or large appliances.

title: Address changes
text: You can change the delivery address only before the order is packed. Once the status shows Packed or Shipped, the address cannot be changed; you can refuse delivery and reorder instead.

title: Return window
text: Most items can be returned within 10 days of delivery. Electronics have a 7 day replacement-only window. Innerwear, perishables and personalised items cannot be returned.

title: Damaged items
text: If an item arrives damaged or broken, raise a request within 48 hours with photos of the item and the outer box. We send a free replacement or a full refund, your choice.

title: Refund timelines
text: Refunds go back to the original payment method. UPI and wallet refunds arrive within 2 business days of the return being picked up. Card refunds take 5 to 7 business days. Cash-on-delivery orders are refunded to your store wallet or a bank account you add.

title: Refund status codes
text: Refund status RF-INIT means the refund is created, RF-BANK means it has been sent to your bank, and RF-DONE means the bank has confirmed it. If status stays at RF-BANK for more than 7 business days, contact your bank with the reference number.

title: Double charges
text: If you were charged twice for one order, the duplicate payment is reversed automatically within 3 business days. If it is not reversed after 3 business days, raise a billing ticket with both transaction ids.

title: EMI options
text: No-cost EMI is available on orders above Rs 3,000 with selected credit cards for 3 or 6 months. Debit card EMI is available for eligible customers on orders above Rs 5,000.

title: Plus membership
text: Plus membership costs Rs 999 per year and gives free express shipping and early sale access. You can cancel any time; a prorated refund is given only if no Plus benefit was used in the current month.

title: Account security
text: We never ask for your OTP, card PIN or password over phone, chat or email. If someone asks for them claiming to be from support, it is a scam; report it from Help > Report fraud.

title: Deleting your account
text: You can delete your account from Settings > Privacy > Delete account. Pending orders and refunds must be completed first. Invoices are kept for 8 years as required for tax records.

title: Warranty claims
text: Manufacturer warranty claims are handled by the brand's service centre. Keep the invoice; you can download it from Orders > Invoice. Model SKU MX-750 mixer grinders carry a 2 year motor warranty.

title: App troubleshooting
text: If the app crashes, update to the latest version, clear the app cache, and restart the phone. If the payments screen still crashes, use the website to pay and report the crash from Help > App issue with your phone model.
